_help: Edit freely; changes apply on the next command (no reload). Only ids in this list can ever be opened. Fields: id (unique, lowercase-dashes), name (what you'd say), aliases (other spoken names; a leading 'open'/'the' is ignored, so don't add 'open X'), description (helps Grok tell similar entries apart, e.g. which app), type 'app' (value = app name as in /Applications) or 'url' (value = any link or app deep link). Optional 'disabled': true hides an entry. Optional 'activate' (url entries): bundle id that should open the link AND come to the front, e.g. com.apple.systempreferences for System Settings panes. Optional 'press' (app entries): {title, role, timeout} = after opening the app, click the UI element with exactly that label via Accessibility (for things with no deep link, e.g. a pinned sidebar item). Keep names/aliases unique across entries (check status.txt for 'alias collisions'). Back up and validate the JSON before saving.
routerNotes: Optional extra rule for the router, e.g. 'Work means Slack, chat with family means WhatsApp.'
